sn45.26:1.2: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the inferior person and the one who is worse than the inferior person.
sn45.26:1.3: I will teach you the superior person and the one who is better than the superior person.
sn45.26:1.5: “And what, bhikkhus, is the inferior person?
sn45.26:1.6: Here someone is of wrong view … wrong concentration.
sn45.26:1.7: This is called the inferior person.
sn45.26:2.1: “And what, bhikkhus, is the one who is worse than the inferior person?
sn45.26:2.2: Here someone is of wrong view … wrong concentration, wrong knowledge, wrong liberation.
sn45.26:2.3: This is called the one who is worse than the inferior person.
sn45.26:3.1: “And what, bhikkhus, is the superior person?
sn45.26:3.2: Here someone is of right view … right concentration.
sn45.26:3.3: This is called the superior person.
sn45.26:4.1: “And what, bhikkhus, is the one who is better than the superior person?
sn45.26:4.2: Here someone is of right view … right concentration, right knowledge, right liberation.
sn45.26:4.3: This is called the one who is better than the superior person.”
